messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: shinyapps in Suggests
parts:
Hi,

I'd like to list the shinyapps package under Suggests for one of my R packages (a function in the package calls deployApp) but I was asked by CRAN if shinyapps could be made available from some repository which could then be
specified via the Additional_repositories field in the Description file.

Right now I can only find the github repo for shinyapps, which isn't the right format. Do you have it somewhere I can point to in Additional_repositories? Or is this something you could do easily (eg using Dirk's drat package, etc)?

Thanks a lot for the great package and ShinyApps service.

Jonah

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: shinyapps in Suggests
parts:
Jonah,

We'll likely release the shinyapps package to CRAN in the next few months (actually it will be a new package called rsconnect). Right now we're in a transition period so we're just waiting to make sure things are settled.

Would it be possible update your package description after that happens?

-Andy

Thanks again,

Jonah

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: shinyapps in Suggests
parts:
Personally I'd just use getFromNamespace('foo', 'shinyapps') instead
of shinyapps::foo and not Suggests shinyapps in DESCRIPTION in such
cases to avoid the CRAN frustration. This is a dirty trick, but should
make both CRAN and you happy (unless they read your source code and
discover what you did, which is unlikely according to my own
experience).

Regards,
Yihui
